title: South African Markets - Factors to watch on Jan. 3 By Reuters
text:
© Reuters. South African Markets - Factors to watch on Jan. 3 The following company announcements, scheduled economic indicators, debt and currency market moves and political events may affect South African markets on Thursday.
SOUTH AFRICAN MARKETS
South Africa's rand weakened more than one percent on Wednesday as weak Chinese manufacturing data offset hopes that a trade war between China and the United States was ending. .J ZAR/
GLOBAL MARKETS
U.S. stock futures fell and Asian shares wobbled on Thursday after a rare revenue warning from Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ) added to worries about slowing global growth and weaker earnings. MKTS/GLOB
WALL STREET
Wall Street edged higher on Wednesday after stumbling out of the starting gate on the first trading day of 2019, while fears of a global economic slowdown were exacerbated after Apple cut its holiday-quarter revenue forecast. .N
GOLD XAU=
Gold prices scaled a more than six-month peak on Thursday as worries about a global economic slowdown and volatility in equities boosted safe-haven buying, while a weaker dollar offered support. GOL/
Some of the main stories out in the South African press:
BUSINESS DAY
- Reserve bank deputy governor resigns
- Food prices may spike as drought takes toll
